architectural_enablers.name: Distributed Valkey Idempotency-Key Coordination Engine
architectural_enablers.rc9_status: SQL-only idempotency_records in internal/ingress/idempotency/guard.go ([SOURCE_VERIFIED]); serializes under high-concurrency retries.
architectural_enablers.proposed_enabler_role: Provides low-latency distributed atomic lock and SHA-256 payload-fingerprint coordination in Valkey (with automatic SQLite/PostgreSQL fallback in single-node Mode A) without changing external Idempotency-Key HTTP behavior.
architectural_enablers.teep_03_deferral: Exact Valkey key TTL eviction, Project-DEK ciphertext envelope format, and failover fallback semantics deferred to TEEP-03.
architectural_enablers.invariants: Strict (org_id, project_id, virtual_key_id) key isolation; response payloads sealed with Project DEK.

architectural_enablers.name: Sub-Millisecond Distributed Budget Admission & Lease Coordination
architectural_enablers.rc9_status: Synchronous per-request SQL Reserve/Settle transactions serialize hot tenant ledgers (contributing to 109.48 req/s SQLite and 56.86 req/s 2-vCPU PG16 HA ceilings [RUNTIME_VERIFIED]).
architectural_enablers.proposed_enabler_role: Decouples routine Data-Plane pre-request budget admission from per-request relational row locks when ample budget headroom exists, transitioning to strict centralized coordination near exhaustion.
architectural_enablers.teep_03_deferral: DEC-CAND-22: Exact distributed budget algorithm (hierarchical escrow-backed pod leases vs Valkey Lua token-bucket sharding vs hybrid watermark cutover) deferred to TEEP-03 architecture evaluation.
architectural_enablers.invariants: Aggregate pre-allocated holds plus settled spend must remain bounded by configured hard budget ceilings; crashed-pod holds reclaimed by bounded-TTL orphan reaper.

architectural_enablers.name: Incremental Watermarked FinOps Rollup Aggregator (usage_rollups_hourly)
architectural_enablers.rc9_status: internal/finops/rollup/aggregator.go has zero non-test callers in serve.go ([SOURCE_VERIFIED]); usage_rollups_hourly remains empty (DEF-078) and iterates all orgs sequentially.
architectural_enablers.proposed_enabler_role: Maintains incremental hourly and daily pre-aggregated FinOps cubes keyed by org, org_unit, project, environment, virtual key, model, provider, cost-center, and usage-accuracy tier using O(k_active_orgs) watermark progression.
architectural_enablers.teep_03_deferral: Exact watermark checkpoint schema, late-arriving stream settlement reconciliation, and rollup retention compaction deferred to TEEP-03.
architectural_enablers.invariants: Exact integer reconciliation against raw usage_settlements plus live tail watermark; zero floating-point aggregation.

architectural_enablers.name: Epoch-Fenced SSRF-Safe Pooled Keep-Alive & HTTP/2 Upstream Transports
architectural_enablers.rc9_status: internal/security/broker/blind_broker.go:876 constructs a fresh http.Transport with DisableKeepAlives: true on every request ([SOURCE_VERIFIED]), forcing per-call TCP+TLS handshakes.
architectural_enablers.proposed_enabler_role: Maintains isolated upstream HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 connection pools partitioned by (org_id, connection_id, policy_digest, origin) with immediate idle-socket eviction on config_epoch, CIDR, TLS, or kill-switch mutations.
architectural_enablers.teep_03_deferral: Pool sizing bounds, idle eviction timers, and reused-socket SSRF IP-revalidation hook mechanics deferred to TEEP-03.
architectural_enablers.invariants: Zero cross-tenant or cross-connection socket reuse; immediate CloseIdleConnections() on revocation, secret rotation, or egress policy change.

architectural_enablers.name: Split SQLite Read/Write Pools & Group-Commit Settlement/Trace Batcher
architectural_enablers.rc9_status: sqlite/store.go:104 sets SetMaxOpenConns(1) ([SOURCE_VERIFIED]) and both SQLite and PostgreSQL execute per-request synchronous INSERT fsyncs on settlements and trace metadata.
architectural_enablers.proposed_enabler_role: Separates concurrent WAL reader pools from a single serialized SQLite writer and batches high-frequency settlement and trace metadata writes into bounded micro-batches (e.g., 5-10 ms or N rows via pgx.CopyFrom / single WAL transaction).
architectural_enablers.teep_03_deferral: Flush window bounds, backpressure queue sizing, and crash-recovery durability acknowledgments deferred to TEEP-03.
architectural_enablers.invariants: Settlement persistence durability acknowledged before budget hold release; bounded in-memory batch queues with explicit shed telemetry.

architectural_enablers.name: Incremental ConfigSnapshot Epoch Delta Synchronization
architectural_enablers.rc9_status: internal/config/snapshot/manager.go:857 executes 2 + 7 * N_orgs full-table RLS queries per pod on every config_epoch bump ([SOURCE_VERIFIED], ARCH-OBS-01 Loop #5).
architectural_enablers.proposed_enabler_role: Replaces full-estate snapshot reloads with incremental entity delta fetches driven by config_changelog epochs (plus optional pre-built signed snapshot bundles for cold pod startup and disconnected regional cells).
architectural_enablers.teep_03_deferral: Delta compaction log retention, copy-on-write persistent map structure, and cold-boot snapshot artifact format deferred to TEEP-03.
architectural_enablers.invariants: Preserves Manager.CheckServingReady() fail-closed stale-snapshot circuit breaker (ADR-0006) and atomic per-org pointer swaps.

architectural_enablers.name: Low-Allocation Hot-Path Buffer & Slice Pooling
architectural_enablers.rc9_status: Per-request JSON parsing, header cloning, and route candidate slices allocate on the Go heap during high-RPS streaming.
architectural_enablers.proposed_enabler_role: Reduces Go garbage-collection pause pressure on Data-Plane nodes via zeroed sync.Pool byte buffers, pre-sized SSE framing buffers, and stack-friendly route candidate evaluation.
architectural_enablers.teep_03_deferral: Buffer class sizes and memory zeroization benchmarks deferred to TEEP-03.
architectural_enablers.invariants: Mandatory clear(buf) zeroization before returning any buffer that carried request, response, or header bytes to a pool.

architectural_enablers.name: BlindHostCredentialBroker Edge Secret Injection & Stream Scrubber Kernel
architectural_enablers.rc9_status: Implemented and verified in internal/security/broker/blind_broker.go ([RUNTIME_VERIFIED] & [SOURCE_VERIFIED]): keeps raw provider credentials out of guest Wasm linear memory, enforces PolicyResolver, blocks outbound Cookie headers (DEC-004), and scrubs secret substrings from error/SSE chunks.
architectural_enablers.proposed_enabler_role: Serves as the mandatory host-side credential injection, cryptographic request signing (SigV4, mTLS, OBO), and secret-redaction kernel for all Provider, MCP, A2A, and Extension outbound calls.
architectural_enablers.teep_03_deferral: Extension of host injection modes for multi-header enterprise auth providers and streaming OBO token refresh deferred to TEEP-03.
architectural_enablers.invariants: Explicit PolicyResolver required; raw credentials never serialized into Wasm guest memory, traces, logs, or audit payloads.

architectural_enablers.name: Connect-Time SSRFGuardDialer IP Pinning, IMDS Fence & Rejection Telemetry
architectural_enablers.rc9_status: Implemented in internal/security/egress/ssrf_guard.go ([RUNTIME_VERIFIED]): resolves DNS once at dial time, blocks link-local/IMDS 169.254.0.0/16 and private ranges unless allow_private_ip + CIDR allowlist match; lacks structured socket-rejection metrics (RR-022).
architectural_enablers.proposed_enabler_role: Enforces DNS-rebinding-resistant socket pinning and CIDR egress policy across every outbound HTTP, OAuth/JWKS, OTLP, Webhook, Git, OCI, MCP, and A2A connection, emitting structured rejection diagnostics.
architectural_enablers.teep_03_deferral: Socket-level rejection counter schema and pooled-connection IP re-verification cadence deferred to TEEP-03.
architectural_enablers.invariants: Cloud metadata IPs (169.254.169.254, fd00:ec2::254) remain blocked even when allow_private_ip=true for local inference servers.

architectural_enablers.name: O(1) audit_chain_heads & audit_partition_seals Storage Indexing
architectural_enablers.rc9_status: internal/security/audit/logger.go:237 probes all monthly partitions while holding pg_advisory_xact_lock ([SOURCE_VERIFIED]), and verifier.go hardcodes expectedSeq := 1 (blocking partition archival).
architectural_enablers.proposed_enabler_role: Maintains constant-time per-chain sequence/hash tip state in audit_chain_heads and stores signed terminal digests in audit_partition_seals before old partitions are detached or archived.
architectural_enablers.teep_03_deferral: Exact advisory lock granularity vs row-level UPDATE locking on audit_chain_heads deferred to TEEP-03.
architectural_enablers.invariants: Gapless RFC 8785 JCS SHA-256 chain continuity across active and sealed historical partitions.

architectural_enablers.name: ARCH-OBS-01 PostgreSQL Composite Index Pack & Scoped Cross-Org Lookup Views
architectural_enablers.rc9_status: 18 sequential O(N_orgs) SetOrgRLSTx loops and 7 missing PostgreSQL composite/partial indexes identified in frozen RC9 ([SOURCE_VERIFIED], ARCH-OBS-01).
architectural_enablers.proposed_enabler_role: Adds the 7 missing PostgreSQL composite/partial indexes, blind HMAC login directory lookup, persisted staged_by_principal_id, and narrowly scoped cross-org operator metadata projections so multi-org lookups scale as O(1) or O(k_affected_orgs) without weakening tenant FORCE RLS.
architectural_enablers.teep_03_deferral: DEC-CAND-12: Exact schema design for SYSTEM operator principal separation (org_id IS NULL vs membership table) and SECURITY DEFINER view boundaries deferred to TEEP-03.
architectural_enablers.invariants: Tenant-scoped callers retain strict PostgreSQL FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY isolation with zero cross-org row visibility.

architectural_enablers.name: Dual-Engine (SQLite <-> PostgreSQL) Schema Parity & N-1 Rolling-Skew Migration Guard
architectural_enablers.rc9_status: DEF-086 exposed VARCHAR(64) truncation in PostgreSQL where SQLite TEXT succeeded; migrations lack automated AST/catalog parity and N-1 rolling-upgrade compatibility checks ([SOURCE_VERIFIED]).
architectural_enablers.proposed_enabler_role: Enforces automated schema-type/constraint parity between db/migrations/sqlite and db/migrations/postgres plus expand-and-contract N-1 binary compatibility during rolling cluster upgrades.
architectural_enablers.teep_03_deferral: Migration lock timeout budgets and online index creation orchestration deferred to TEEP-03.
architectural_enablers.invariants: Zero destructive column drops or narrowing casts in minor/patch rolling upgrade paths.

architectural_enablers.name: Valkey Failover & valkey_hold_checkpoints Reconciliation Protocol
architectural_enablers.rc9_status: DR-02 checkpoint table exists, but automated Valkey replica promotion and live under-load hold reconciliation remain unverified (RR-010, COND-PO-03 [RUNTIME_VERIFIED]).
architectural_enablers.proposed_enabler_role: Coordinates Valkey connection failover, periodic hold checkpointing, and deterministic ledger reconciliation so Valkey restarts or primary promotions do not leak permanently orphaned budget holds.
architectural_enablers.teep_03_deferral: Exact reconciliation epoch fencing during split-brain Valkey Sentinel/Cluster failover deferred to TEEP-03.
architectural_enablers.invariants: Fail-closed or bounded-fallback policy per tenant configuration with explicit degraded-state alerting (PG-007).

architectural_enablers.name: Zero-Ambient-Authority Tier-2 Wasm Sandbox Kernel
architectural_enablers.rc9_status: Verified in internal/extension/wasmrt (14.57 us/op [RUNTIME_VERIFIED], 16 MiB linear memory ceiling, 50 ms deadline, 0 WASI host sockets/filesystem, FaultGuard auto-quarantine).
architectural_enablers.proposed_enabler_role: Executes untrusted and partner Tier-2 extension modules in pure Go (CGO_ENABLED=0) with deterministic memory/CPU bounds, per-tenant fair queuing, and automatic fault containment across all Wasm-capable extension categories.
architectural_enablers.teep_03_deferral: DEC-CAND-11: wazero vs build-time WIT lowering and TypeScript QuickJS-ng Wasm snapshot mechanics deferred to TEEP-03.
architectural_enablers.invariants: CGO_ENABLED=0 static binary preserved; zero ambient filesystem, clock, env, or raw socket imports exposed to guest modules.

architectural_enablers.name: Deterministic Cross-OS .tpkg Archive Builder & Reproducible Wasm Build Pipeline
architectural_enablers.rc9_status: BLOCKED by RR-001 / DEF-043 ([RUNTIME_VERIFIED]): builtin.NewCatalog embeds 2-3 files vs plugin pack walking 10-15 files, CRLF vs LF line endings diverge on Windows, runtime gzip varies across Go versions, and build-wasm.sh omits aws-bedrock.
architectural_enablers.proposed_enabler_role: Unifies built-in and CLI extension packaging onto one canonical file-inclusion ruleset, POSIX LF normalization, pinned containerized Wasm toolchain (including aws-bedrock), and cross-OS (Linux/macOS/Windows) bit-reproducible digest verification.
architectural_enablers.teep_03_deferral: DEC-CAND-04: Final canonical signature target (Canonical File-Tree Merkle Manifest tanpopo:tpkg-tree:v1 vs deterministic uncompressed/pinned archive bytes) deferred to TEEP-03.
architectural_enablers.invariants: Production private signing keys remain strictly offline/owner-controlled; GATE-REL-07 remains enforced.

architectural_enablers.name: Asynchronous Transactional Webhook & Notification Outbox Dispatcher
architectural_enablers.rc9_status: webhook_event_outbox lacks a pending tenant index on PostgreSQL, runs O(N_orgs) polling, and is inserted twice on quarantine ([SOURCE_VERIFIED], ARCH-OBS-01 Loop #10).
architectural_enablers.proposed_enabler_role: Writes domain notification events atomically inside the originating Control-Plane transaction and fans out deliveries asynchronously across In-App, Email, Telegram, ChatOps, SIEM, and Webhook channels with exponential backoff, jitter, circuit breaking, and dead-letter persistence.
architectural_enablers.teep_03_deferral: Outbox partitioning, worker lease sharding, and deduplication window storage deferred to TEEP-03.
architectural_enablers.invariants: Outbound network calls pass through SSRFGuardDialer + BlindHostCredentialBroker; slow notification sinks never block Control-Plane transactions.

architectural_enablers.name: Host blob.Store Zero-Copy Multimodal Splicing & Binary EventStream Framing
architectural_enablers.rc9_status: blob.Store splices >64 KiB base64 attachments up to 32 MiB in Host RAM, but lacks streaming multipart upload forwarding and AWS binary application/vnd.amazon.eventstream framing ([SOURCE_VERIFIED]).
architectural_enablers.proposed_enabler_role: Streams large multimodal documents, audio, images, and binary vendor event frames through bounded host buffers so Wasm adapters inspect compact metadata references without exceeding their 16 MiB linear memory cap.
architectural_enablers.teep_03_deferral: Streaming chunk-splicing state machine and CRC32 binary frame verifier details deferred to TEEP-03.
architectural_enablers.invariants: Strict per-request memory ceiling and immediate temporary blob zeroization/release on request completion.

architectural_enablers.name: Host-Owned Declarative Extension UI Renderer & Sandbox Isolation Bridge
architectural_enablers.rc9_status: ABSENT_IN_RC9: Extensions have no mechanism to contribute settings forms, report views, widgets, or contextual actions in the Web Console.
architectural_enablers.proposed_enabler_role: Parses schema-validated declarative UI descriptors declared in .tpkg manifests and renders them exclusively through host-owned @astryxdesign/core components (forms, tables, metric strips, banners, drawers, row actions) bound to RBAC- and CSRF-enforced host proxy endpoints.
architectural_enablers.teep_03_deferral: DEC-CAND-17: Declarative UI descriptor grammar, data-binding pagination limits, and whether an optional sandboxed-iframe escape hatch is ever permitted are deferred to TEEP-03.
architectural_enablers.invariants: Zero arbitrary third-party JavaScript execution in the Admin Console origin; zero external CDN/network requests; preserves Astryx Neutral Light/Dark, WCAG 2.2 AA, and 15-locale fallback parity.

non_functional_requirements.title: Clustered Data-Plane Sustained Throughput & Latency Overhead
non_functional_requirements.rc9_baseline: 56.86 req/s on 2-vCPU Docker PG16 HA ([RUNTIME_VERIFIED], benchmark-evidence.md).
non_functional_requirements.target_hypothesis: Sustained >= 10,000 RPS (>= 2,500 RPS per 4-vCPU DP pod) mixed Tier-1/Tier-2 traffic against 20 ms mock upstream with gateway internal overhead p95 < 2.5 ms, p99 < 8.0 ms, and 0.00% internal 5xx ([HYPOTHESIS]).

non_functional_requirements.title: Single-Node SQLite Standalone Throughput
non_functional_requirements.target_hypothesis: Sustained >= 1,500 req/s short-context requests on a 2-vCPU / 2 GiB Mode A node with p95 < 15 ms internal queue wait ([HYPOTHESIS]).

non_functional_requirements.title: Workforce Offboarding & Emergency Revocation Propagation Latency
non_functional_requirements.rc9_baseline: SCIM absent; global extension quarantine omits direct Valkey publishChange ([SOURCE_VERIFIED]).
non_functional_requirements.target_hypothesis: 100% of sessions, PATs, personal OAuth grants, Virtual Keys, and active SSE/MCP streams terminated cluster-wide in p99 < 5.0 s upon SCIM active=false or emergency kill-switch ([HYPOTHESIS]).

non_functional_requirements.title: Noisy-Neighbor Tail-Latency & Resource Containment
non_functional_requirements.rc9_baseline: Per-key rate limits only; no org-aggregate bulkhead or pod shuffle sharding ([SOURCE_VERIFIED]).
non_functional_requirements.target_hypothesis: Under a 20,000 RPS single-tenant burst on a 16-pod cluster, >= 99% of sibling organizations observe < 0.5 ms p99 gateway overhead delta and 0.00% dropped requests ([HYPOTHESIS]).

non_functional_requirements.title: Workload Identity Verification Resilience Under IdP Outage
non_functional_requirements.target_hypothesis: Stale-while-revalidate JWKS/SPIFFE trust bundle cache sustains 100% verification for known signing keys during a 10-minute upstream IdP 503 outage at p95 < 0.15 ms ([HYPOTHESIS]).

non_functional_requirements.title: Concurrent Budget Exhaustion Ceiling Enforcement
non_functional_requirements.rc9_baseline: Single-row SQL/Lua pre-holds enforce hard caps at low RPS ([RUNTIME_VERIFIED]).
non_functional_requirements.target_hypothesis: 100 concurrent callers across 8 pods racing against USD 5.00 remaining hard budget produce 0 micro-USD unauthorized pre-hold ceiling overrun ([HYPOTHESIS]).

non_functional_requirements.title: Subject Erasure Completion Without Audit Hash-Chain Corruption
non_functional_requirements.rc9_baseline: Per-subject HMAC salt-shredding absent in RC9 ([SOURCE_VERIFIED]).
non_functional_requirements.target_hypothesis: Destroying subject_privacy_keys completes in < 15 s across 10,000 historical audit/settlement records while VerifyAuditChain passes 100% with 0 broken RFC 8785 JCS hashes ([HYPOTHESIS]).

non_functional_requirements.title: Regional Data-Plane Survivability During Control-Plane WAN Partition
non_functional_requirements.rc9_baseline: Data-plane stale-snapshot fail-closed breaker trips after 10s without Control Plane connectivity (ADR-0006 [RUNTIME_VERIFIED]).
non_functional_requirements.target_hypothesis: Configured sovereign regional cells continue serving regional traffic against local PG/Valkey and regional budget envelopes during a 4-hour WAN partition from central Control Plane at >= 99.99% cell availability and 0 cross-region egress ([HYPOTHESIS]).

non_functional_requirements.title: 10,000-Organization Control-Plane & Snapshot Scalability (ARCH-OBS-01)
non_functional_requirements.rc9_baseline: 18 sequential O(N_orgs) RLS loops cause linear query amplification (e.g., 2 + 7 * N_orgs per pod on snapshot refresh [SOURCE_VERIFIED]).
non_functional_requirements.target_hypothesis: Global quarantine commit + Valkey broadcast completes in p99 < 50 ms and incremental Snapshot.Refresh completes in p99 < 25 ms at 10,000 organizations ([HYPOTHESIS]).

non_functional_requirements.title: Zero-Drop Rolling Cluster Upgrades Under Active SSE Streaming
non_functional_requirements.rc9_baseline: 1 / 575 (0.17%) requests dropped at LB drain boundary during rolling restart ([RUNTIME_VERIFIED], benchmark-evidence.md).
non_functional_requirements.target_hypothesis: preStop readiness fencing + active SSE stream draining achieves 0 dropped requests across a 4-pod rolling upgrade under 2,000 RPS active streaming ([HYPOTHESIS]).

non_functional_requirements.title: PostgreSQL Multi-Node Vault KEK Rotation & Retirement Safety
non_functional_requirements.rc9_baseline: handleRetireMasterKEK has a [SOURCE_VERIFIED] suspected PG FORCE RLS 0-count visibility hazard (FND-001).
non_functional_requirements.target_hypothesis: Premature KEK retirement deterministically rejects with 409 org_deks_not_rewrapped whenever >= 1 tenant DEK uses that KEK under PG16 FORCE RLS; post-rewrap retirement scrubs retired KEK bytes across all pods in p99 < 5.0 s ([HYPOTHESIS]).

non_functional_requirements.title: Zero-External-Egress Air-Gapped Operation
non_functional_requirements.target_hypothesis: 100% of Console, CLI, extension bundle, offline model catalog, and offline advisory workflows execute with 0 outbound DNS/TCP/HTTPS packets when external feeds are disabled ([HYPOTHESIS]).

non_functional_requirements.title: WCAG 2.2 AA Accessibility & Astryx Neutral Visual Parity
non_functional_requirements.rc9_baseline: 0 axe-core violations and Light/Dark Astryx Neutral tokens verified across 15 RC9 Console screens ([RUNTIME_VERIFIED]).
non_functional_requirements.target_hypothesis: Maintain 0 axe-core violations, full keyboard/screen-reader operability, Light/Dark parity, single <h1> per page, zero horizontal page overflow across 320-1920 px, and zero decorative badges across all new core and declarative extension UI views.

non_functional_requirements.title: 15-Language Offline Localization & Zero Raw Enum Leaks
non_functional_requirements.rc9_baseline: 15 locale bundles shipped, but PG-003 exposed untranslated raw enum strings on FinOps/MCP screens ([RUNTIME_VERIFIED]).

non_functional_requirements.title: Initial Web Console JavaScript Payload Ceiling
non_functional_requirements.rc9_baseline: Initial Console JS bundle <= 250 KB gzip enforced by build gate ([RUNTIME_VERIFIED]).
non_functional_requirements.target_hypothesis: Keep initial route-critical JS payload <= 250 KB gzip via route-level code-splitting for heavy workspaces (Topology Graph, What-If Simulator, Playground, Marketplace) and zero external runtime scripts.

non_functional_requirements.title: Fuzzing, Dual-Backend Parity & Unsigned Build E2E Coverage
non_functional_requirements.rc9_baseline: >=4h fuzzing unexecuted (COND-PO-01); CI E2E injected test signer masking unsigned Day-0 403 ([SOURCE_VERIFIED]).

non_functional_requirements.title: CGO_ENABLED=0 Static Single-Binary & Cross-Platform Parity
non_functional_requirements.rc9_baseline: CGO_ENABLED=0 Go build verified across Linux/macOS/Windows ([RUNTIME_VERIFIED]); RR-001 blocks cross-OS .tpkg digest parity.

non_functional_requirements.title: Permissive Open-Source Dependency Hygiene
